programmes.t: Big Time Presents: Nissan S14 Build
programmes.d: A neglected Nissan S14 is completely transformed into a drift-ready machine.
Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas work on gluing the front panel on the 442 Restomod. This 67 Mercury Cougar has some issues with the rear brake pads.

Jay brings Dan a 2012 Camaro ZL1 with poor performance and a blown supercharger. Terry wants Dan to complete a high-powered restomod of a 1931 Landau Phaeton, but the car arrives with mismatched parts and an engine that should have stayed in the junkyard.

Chris asks FantomWorks to breathe new life into a 1951 Mercury Woody that was sitting in a chicken coop for thirty years. Dan’s 1970 Mustang Boss arrives with a long list of problems and the speed of a sea slug.

Mike thought his 1967 Chevy K10 Pick Up needed paint improvement. Dan quickly realizes that the car needs much more. Nobody restores 1970 Opel Kadett, so there are no parts anywhere for Harry’s car that needs a lot of everything.

A 1983 Avanti shows up with $58,000 worth of mismatched parts and an escalating cascade of hidden problems. A 3100 Chevy Pick-up rolls in with rope holding the doors shut, but the team soon learns that this is the tip of a very ugly iceberg.

Kim and Doug want to drive her father’s hyper-rare 1959 Thunderbolt, but the car was only set up for the racetrack. Batalla is a legendary motorcycle builder who asks Dan to restore his prized possession - a 1947 Knucklehead.

In honor of wounded veterans, Dan and the team attempt a near-impossible conversion by making a 1970 Chevelle SS handicapped accessible. The shop's first pre-war restoration of a 1926 Velie with no manuals or parts takes them into uncharted territory.
Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are tackling the electrical of the 1966 Blue Mustang. The 1969 Chevelle Malibu is in the paint shop.
A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.
Vinnie and the team are putting the frame on the body of the 1964 Corvette Restomod. After they have the body put together they work on putting the door hinges on.
Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas install airbags on the 48 Dodge. Team gets ready for the Galveston Classic Car show.

Mickey’s 1970 Chevelle is perfect, but he wants FantomWorks to tear it apart and upgrade everything to make it his own. Thom’s 1963 Studebaker is a project car with a nightmare combination of leaks, bad parts and a rusted-out floor held together by glue.

David is a Volkswagen fanatic who wants a 1967 Beetle that can outmatch muscle cars. Robert wants a widened 1967 Corvette supercar, but first FantomWorks have to undo the bad repairs from at least three fiberglass rending accidents.

Brad wants a 1967 Mustang Coupe to be new again; so Dan has to fight the way the car was initially built by the factory. Jay wants a stunning 1965 TR4, but he plans to do most of the work himself. Instead, the Fantomworks side of the job keeps growing.
Karoline og Mathilde sætter fokus på kvinder i motorcykelverdenen og møder seje riders fra hele landet.

Scott’s 1953 Fleetwood is a monumental challenge that takes a turn to the crazy when Dan has to add rare features that the car never had in the first place. John wants FantomWorks to make his 1967 Mercury Cougar roaring more fiercely than ever.
Vinnie and the team are fresh off of winning some awards in Galveston, Texas. Moody Gardens Classic Car show is always a blast.
Diagnosing & fixing horsepower loss on a Foxbody Mustang. Causes, solutions, and real dyno results.
A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

The 63 Z06 is getting more fiber glass work done on the inside. Vinnie is working on replacing the windows on the 442 and putting the guts in the door. Plus, we head to Galveston for the Galveston Corvette Show.

programmes.d: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.
Vinnie is in Scottsdale Arizona for Barrett Jackson 2024. There is so much happening, from checking out awesome vendors, looking at awesome classic cars, and even trying amazing food.

Walter loves the fast and futuristic look of his 1975 Bricklin. Unfortunately, the car drives like something from the dark ages. Dan restores a 1963 Split Window Corvette for a pair of owners who know him well – his Uncle Carl and Aunt Claire.
Vinnie and Jan are visiting Mecum Auctions in Houston, Texas checking out some of the coolest classic muscle cars about to hit the auction block!

Dave traded for his dream 1957 Corvette more than three decades ago, but his plans to build it have so far come to nothing. Ken chose a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father’s collection and its now on FantomWorks to reverse the hands of time.
Vinnie and the team are hard at work on the 1976 Trans Am. The 1972 Corvette is getting a custom paint job. The 66 Mustang needs a tune up.

A 1977 Corvette Stingray arrives with seven layers of paint and too many problems to count. The restoration makes no sense, but Dan takes it. A 1965 Cobra is brought in for a simple wiring job. Then, the owner decides to wrap the car like a fighter jet.

programmes.t: Big Time Presents: Nissan S14 Build
programmes.d: The crew revives the neglected Nissan S14 by rebuilding its engine from scratch.

When Ovide purchased his 1957 Bel Air sight unseen, the car was a rusted piece of junk so it’s on Dan to figure out how to restore this classic. Dino loves to go fast. His 1969 Super Bee is anything but super. Dan is tasked to feed Dino’s need for speed.
Chris and Wayner forgo family time between performances to join local racer and wild man, Billy for an afternoon of shooting guns and blowing stuff up.

programmes.t: Big Time Presents: Nissan S14 Build
programmes.d: The crew prepares the rebuilt Nissan S14 for its first real test at Willow Springs.
